headline: Their top complaint is customer support, not the app.
comparison_note: There is no earlier month report to compare with, so no change from the month before is shown. The October 2026 report is a later month, not a baseline.
release_note: No September release stands out. The main versions all sit within a few points of the month average. Reviews with no app version are the outlier, with a much higher 1-star share, and are worth a look with the app team.

actions.title: Fix how tickets get closed
actions.text: Support comes up in [[complaints.share@code=support|pct]] of written complaints, ahead of late delivery at [[complaints.share@code=late|pct]]. Users describe tickets closed with no fix. Audit a sample of closed tickets for real resolution.
actions.measure: support share of complaints in October

actions.title: Look at the late-night experience
actions.text: 8 pm to midnight averages [[windows.avg_rating@window=night|dec2]], below the month average of [[kpis.avg_rating#0|dec2]]. Check rider supply and delivery-time promises in that window.

actions.title: Check reply coverage on 1-star reviews
actions.text: The data shows [[kpis.one_star_unreplied#0|int]] one-star reviews with no reply, but the September reply data looks incomplete, so confirm the real reply rate first. Then cover every 1-star review with a reply that names the issue.
actions.measure: 1-star reply rate and share of templated replies
